summary: Email verification feature fully tested - all backend and frontend tests pass. Registration returns email_verification_required=true without session_token, login blocked with 403 for unverified users, existing users (admin/provider) can still login, verify-email and resend-verification endpoints work correctly, frontend shows appropriate UI states for all flows.

registration_flow.details: POST /api/auth/register returns email_verification_required=true and does NOT return session_token

login_blocked_unverified.details: POST /api/auth/login returns 403 with detail='email_not_verified' for new unverified users

existing_users_exempt.admin_login: admin@carelink.co.il can login successfully (exempt from verification)
existing_users_exempt.provider_login: provider@carelink.co.il can login successfully (exempt from verification)

verify_email_endpoint.invalid_token: Returns 400 with detail='invalid_token' for invalid tokens

resend_verification_endpoint.unknown_email: Returns 200 for unknown email (security - prevents enumeration)

frontend_register_verification_ui.details: After registration shows verification sent UI with envelope icon, email address, and resend button

frontend_login_not_verified_warning.details: When unverified user tries to login, shows amber warning box with 'email not verified' message and resend verification button

frontend_verify_email_page.error_state: Shows error state with red X icon for invalid tokens
frontend_verify_email_page.success_state: Has success state with 'go to login' button

critical_code_review_comments: Email verification logic correctly checks: role != 'admin' AND email_verified == False AND 'email_verified' field exists in user doc
This ensures existing users without email_verified field are exempt from verification
Verification token expires after 24 hours with proper cleanup
Frontend properly handles all states: verificationSent, emailNotVerified, success, expired, error
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test users with emails like test_<timestamp>@test.com for verification testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email verification feature is fully implemented and tested. New user registration flow: 1) Register returns email_verification_required=true, 2) User cannot login (403 email_not_verified), 3) User clicks verification link from email, 4) GET /api/auth/verify-email?token=xxx verifies email, 5) User can now login. Existing users (admin, provider without email_verified field) are exempt. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_email_verification.py has 9 comprehensive tests.

mocked_apis.note: SMTP email sending is configured and executes - actual emails are sent but won't arrive in test environment
